assay_or_perturbation: IGF1 stimulation; α6β4/IGF1R complex perturbation; PI3K-AKT/ERK and adhesion assays
evidence_summary: IGF1R–α6β4 crosstalk was associated with PI3K-AKT/ERK and adhesion or survival outputs.
limitations: The crosstalk complex does not establish a terminal TF or SCI-specific output.

assay_or_perturbation: IGF2 stimulation; IGF1R and α6β4 perturbation; PI3K-AKT/ERK and adhesion assays
evidence_summary: IGF2/IGF1R–α6β4 crosstalk was associated with PI3K-AKT/ERK and adhesion outputs.
limitations: No terminal TF or SCI-specific receiver-cell program was assigned.

assay_or_perturbation: NRG1 wild-type/3KE mutant; ERBB3 phosphorylation; integrin β3/β4 co-precipitation; PI3K-AKT/ERK and proliferation assays
evidence_summary: NRG1 induced ERBB3 phosphorylation, PI3K-AKT/ERK activation and co-precipitation of integrin β3/β4 with ERBB3; the 3KE mutant disrupted these effects.
limitations: The exact α6β4 versus αVβ3 contribution is context-dependent and no terminal TF target was assigned.
